description_en: Queries the details of a serverless job by job ID or subtask ID (for array jobs). Currently, only a single job ID or a single subtask ID can be specified
description_zh: 按照作业ID或子任务ID（数组作业）查询Serverless作业详细信息。当前仅支持传入单个作业ID或单个子任务ID
name: DescribeServerlessJobs

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to obtain the cluster ID

集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of serverless job IDs or subtask IDs (for array jobs).
If the serverless job is an array job, only subtask IDs are supported. The subtask ID format is: <array job ID>_<subtask index>. For example, 10_3 indicates the subtask with index 3 in the array job with ID 10.
Currently, only one element can be specified in this list
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless作业ID或子任务ID（数组作业）列表。
当Serverless作业为数组作业时，仅支持传入子任务ID。子任务ID格式为：<数组作业ID>_<子任务索引>。例如：10_3表示ID为10的数组作业中索引为3的子任务。
该列表当前仅支持传入一个元素

StdinOnce.description_en: When standard input is set to true, the standard input stream remains in the enabling status across multiple attach sessions. If StdinOnce is set to true, standard input is opened when the container starts and remains empty until the first client attaches to it. It then stays open and can accept data until the client disconnects, at which point standard input is in shutdown and remains in shutdown until the container restarts
StdinOnce.description_zh: 当标准输入为true时，标准输入流将在多个附加会话中保持开启状态。如果StdinOnce设为true，标准输入在容器开启时被打开，在首个客户端附加到标准输入之前都为空，然后会一直保持开启状态，接收数据，直到客户端连接断开，此时标准输入被关闭，在容器重启前一直保持关闭状态

HostToContainer: The volume senses subsequent mount operations on this volume or its subdirectories.

None：该卷不感知任何后续在此卷或其子目录上执行的挂载操作。
HostToContainer：该卷将会感知到后续在此卷或其子目录上的挂载操作。
